lessons.title: Prepositions of Time: in, on, at
lessons.content: Use 'in' with parts of the day, months, and years. Use 'on' with days and dates. Use 'at' with times, night, and the weekend.

details.concept: In with parts of the day, months, years
details.explanation: Use 'in' with parts of the day (morning, afternoon, evening), months (September, December), and years (1990, 2021).
details.example: I study Spanish in the evening. They start school in June. My father died in 1987.
details.burmese: 'in' ကို နေ့ပိုင်း (morning, afternoon, evening)၊ လတွေ (September, December)၊ နှစ်တွေ (1990, 2021) နဲ့ သုံးပါ။

details.explanation: Use 'on' with days (Monday, Sunday) and specific dates (20th December, 14th July).
details.example: Can you come on Monday? Schools start on 7th September.
details.burmese: 'on' ကို နေ့တွေ (Monday, Sunday) နဲ့ ရက်စွဲတွေ (20th December, 14th July) နဲ့ သုံးပါ။

details.concept: At with times, night, the weekend
details.explanation: Use 'at' with specific times (six o'clock, half past eight), night, and the weekend.
details.example: We start school at half past eight. We do homework at night. She wants to go to school at the weekend.
details.burmese: 'at' ကို အချိန်တွေ (six o'clock, half past eight)၊ night နဲ့ the weekend နဲ့ သုံးပါ။
